answer_1.quote: we study sign language translation (SLT), the task of translating continuous signing video into written language sentences.
answer_1.outputs: English sentences generated from sign language video

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we report BLEU-{1,2,3,4} and ROUGE scores, as in prior work on SLT. As there is only one English sentence as reference for evaluation, we also report BLEURT score.
